mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, let's take a moment to really let this sink in. Love—it’s so much more than just a feeling or a passing spark, isn’t it? It’s a choice. A practice. Something we carry with us into each day, even when it feels tough. Sure, the path isn’t always smooth. Old hurts, the weight of expectations, and the fear of opening up can make us want to hide away. But here’s the thing: every small act of love matters. Every little bit counts. So, what can you carry forward from all this? Remember—love isn’t about getting it perfect. It’s about showing up, again and again. Whether you’re healing old wounds, reaching out to your community, or simply being gentle with yourself, it all adds up. You’ll find that grief and loss aren’t failures—they’re just part of the journey. And when you dare to reimagine what love can look like, you open the door to new ways of connecting and caring. You don’t need all the answers. You don’t have to never mess up. What matters is your willingness to be honest, to listen, and to keep trying, even when it’s hard. If you ever feel uncertain, just know—you’re not the only one. We all struggle with love sometimes, and we all have the power to grow. So start small. Offer a little kindness, to yourself and to someone else. Notice those moments where love shows up—a warm smile, a gentle word, a helping hand. Let them guide you. Because over time, those moments create a life that feels rich, connected, and full of meaning. The world really does need more love—real, practiced, everyday love. And it all begins with you.
